field.label: Enable download protection
field.help: Checks files downloaded through the firewall for dangerous file types and known malware hashes. This is not a signature-based virus scanner: it recognises files that are already known to be bad and controls risky file types.

field.label: Scan plain HTTP downloads
field.help: Unencrypted web downloads are checked transparently. Most sites use HTTPS; see below.

field.label: Known malware hashes
field.help: The SHA-256 of every download is looked up in the feed, your own list and the EICAR test file.

field.label: Installer packages (msi, apk, jar, dmg, iso ...)
Archives (zip, rar, 7z, gz ...)
field.help: Archives are not opened; only the archive file itself is looked up.

field.label: Malware hash feed URL
field.help: A text or CSV file with one SHA-256 per line, for example an export from abuse.ch MalwareBazaar (it needs a free key) or your own list. Leave empty to use only your own hashes.

field.label: Feed key
field.help: Sent as an "Auth-Key" header (abuse.ch). Leave empty if the feed needs none.

field.label: Never scan these sites
field.help: Trusted download sites, separated by commas. Example: downloads.example.com

field.label: Largest file looked up (MB)
field.help: Bigger files pass unlooked; file types are still recorded.
